parameter_semantics: lid_pose_field names the currently observed world pose [metres, unit wxyz] of the manipulated moving lid. It is resolved at every replan and again from the fresh current observation for every decoded action; training binds it to lid_pose.
output_semantics: Each slot is [lid-frame TCP translation xyz in metres, lid-frame TCP rotation as the first two rotation-matrix columns (6D), native gripper scalar]. At training slot s, the frame is the observed lid_pose before that demonstrated action. At execution, slots 1..8 (t..t+7) are each converted using the fresh current lid_pose, not a predicted future pose: T_world_tcp = T_world_lid_current * T_lid_tcp. The 6D value is projected to SO(3) by Gram-Schmidt with a deterministic finite fallback. The resulting world TCP target is passed only to panda_kinematics.solve_ik from freshly measured qpos. The returned gripper scalar preserves the executor rule >=0 open and <0 close.

conversion_check.description: For demonstration labels, lid-relative encode followed by decode with the matching pre-action lid observation reconstructs the commanded world TCP pose. The shared IK is then checked by FK; position metres, rotation radians and unchanged gripper scalar must have maximum error at most 0.005. SO(3) projection is exact for encoded rotation matrices and only regularizes sampled degenerate 6D values.

cut_relation: Uses every assigned action in all twelve [0,950) slices. It preserves the full approach, handle closure, hinge pull, release and retreat responsibility, including the complete action-supervised [740,950) overlap with retrieve_peg_from_box; only the Cartesian representation is changed to the observed lid frame.
